_meta_itemized.notes: Roger Armstrong, County Council, 2020 Pre-Election. Typed sheets on the 2020 blank form, clean scan with a faithful OCR text layer. A wholly self-funded filing: both contributions are the candidate's own money and both expenditures are to the Summit County Clerk (filing fee + voter list), netting to a $0 balance. SOURCE PROPERTY THE BRIEF DOES NOT LIST: this filer did not merely leave the template SPECIMEN rows in place - he STRUCK THEM THROUGH with a pen/line ('04/15/20 Jon & Jane Doe / P.O. Box 128, Coalville, UT / 84017 / $435.00' on p2, and '04/15/20 Name of Business / Campaign signs & flyers / $512.00' on p3). The strike-through is the filer's own explicit statement that they are not transactions, which corroborates the wave's existing drop rule from the document side rather than only from the arithmetic. The expense specimen prints $512.00 here (the brief cites $512.00 - confirmed) and the contribution specimen $435.00. Privacy: the sheet has a Mailing Address column and both real rows carry a street address; the street was discarded at read time and only city/state ('Park City', 'UT') are recorded. ROW-BAND CAVEAT: rowbands over-split the populated top of both tables (31 bands on p2, 40 on p3 against ~25 physical table rows) because the strike-through lines and the two-line header register as rules; each row used here was individually crop-verified, and the bands cited are the ones whose boxes actually contain their rows. No in-kind schedule, no redactions, no period/cumulative ambiguity (single_total cover, current_report column only, Pre-Election).
